definitions.explanation: An activity or entertainment that takes one's mind off worries or boredom. Implies a pleasant, refreshing change of pace rather than deep engagement.

examples.japanese: {気散|きさん}じ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I went for a walk as a diversion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合間|あいま}→合間：05708_aima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気散|きさん}じ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいる→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read books as a diversion between work tasks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{看病|かんびょう}→看病：16956_kanbyou⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{気散|きさん}じ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なれば→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I gave movie tickets to my mother, who was exhausted from nursing care, hoping it would be a nice distraction.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (spirit/mood) + {散|さん} (scatter) + じ (a classical suffix). Literally "scattering one's spirit," meaning to relieve mental tension through a pleasant activity. Has an old-fashioned, slightly literary flavor.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {気散|きさん}じ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as a diversion; for amusement
- {気散|きさん}じ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as a distraction
- {気散|きさん}じ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do something for diversion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気分転換|きぶんてんかん}→気分転換：08691_kibuntenkan⟧: change of pace; mood refresh — the modern, everyday equivalent
- ⟦{暇潰|ひまつぶ}し→暇潰し：10606_himatsubushi⟧: killing time — more casual, implies boredom rather than stress relief
- ⟦{娯楽|ごらく}→娯楽：00074_goraku⟧: entertainment; recreation — broader term for leisure activities in general
